textos.Lançado em 2023 e dirigido por Justine T: Released in 2023 and directed by Justine Triet, Anatomy of a Fall combines elements of suspense, mystery and crime drama. The plot follows a woman who becomes the main suspect after her husband's death, while the couple's visually impaired son finds himself facing a moral dilemma as the only witness in the case.
textos.A obra se estrutura a partir de um ritmo: The work is structured around a slowed-down pace and a procedural approach that dwells in detail on testimonies and inquiries. Throughout its running time, the film maintains a sober tone and an investigative atmosphere that refuses to offer categorical resolutions.
